results.statement: For the atm-core steps that the Justfile recipes _py, sc_lint_clippy_prefix and _sc-lint-clippy run today, sc-lint must itself select the .bootstrap-venv interpreter those recipes select.
results.quote:
atm-core can delete its Justfile glue (_py, sc_lint_clippy_prefix, _sc-lint-clippy) because sc-lint runs the setup step and uses the right Python itself.
Definition question (team-lead, 2026-10-30): "is \"the right Python\" the interpreter those three recipes select today, which is `.bootstrap-venv`?" Rand: "yes"
results.context: Phase M planning; Rand approved the sentence and answered 'yes' to the definition question, relayed by team-lead 2026-10-30
results.deterministic_check: Runner tests with stub interpreters show each atm-core step class gets its intended interpreter with no consumer per-OS path.
